definitions.explanation: A traditional Japanese dessert consisting of a sweet soup made from azuki beans, typically served with mochi (rice cakes). Especially popular in winter.

⟦{寒|さむ}い→寒い：00664_samui⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{温|あたた}かい→温かい：13395_atatakai⟧ぜんざい⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{幸|しあわ}せな⟦{気分|きぶん}→気分：01306_kibun⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。

examples.english: My grandmother made zenzai from scratch with azuki beans, so the whole family ate it together.

notes:
A beloved traditional Japanese sweet, especially in winter. Can be written in kanji as {善哉|ぜんざい}, but hiragana is more common in everyday use. The definition varies by region in Japan.

REGIONAL DIFFERENCES:
In the Kanto (Tokyo) region, ぜんざい usually refers to a version with whole beans and mochi. In the Kansai (Osaka/Kyoto) region, the same dish is called {汁粉|しるこ} if it uses smooth bean paste, while ぜんざい refers specifically to the chunky version with whole beans.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ぜんざい⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧: to make zenzai
- ぜんざい⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧: to eat zenzai
- ⟦{温|あたた}かい→温かい：13395_atatakai⟧ぜんざい: warm zenzai
- ⟦お{餅|もち}→お餅：23451_omochi⟧{入|い}りぜんざい: zenzai with mochi

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {汁粉|しるこ}: sweet red bean soup — similar dish; in Kanto, uses smooth paste; in Kansai, synonymous with ぜんざい
- ⟦{餡子|あんこ}→餡子：08654_anko⟧: sweet red bean paste — the paste itself, not a soup
- ⟦{和菓子|わがし}→和菓子：04962_wagashi⟧: Japanese sweets — the broader category
